title: Sea of Chaos: Arena
tagline: A pirate battle royale for 2-person crews. Sink rivals, grab treasure, outrun the storm, dodge the Megalodon.

roles.name: Pirate
roles.description: Host an arena or join with its 4-letter code. Crews of two share a ship: one sails, one fights and repairs.

multiplayer.notes: 4 players make two crews of 2; a 5th gets a ship with an AI Deckhand. Fewer than 4 players and AI pirate ships fill the arena. Solo play works offline.

requires: internet (three.js and fonts load from CDNs)
